name: Zak Radio
description: Add songs to this music library using an upload API key and a binary MP3 file.
url_resolution: Resolve all paths against the origin that served this document. Send credentials only to that origin. Do not follow redirects with credentials.

authentication.get_key: The user signs in, opens Library > API access, selects Create upload key, and supplies the one-time secret through your secret store.
authentication.revocation: The user can revoke the key in Library > API access.
authentication.credential_handling: Never print the key or include it in prompts, URLs, source files, or logs. Upload keys cannot manage keys, control stations, or replace songs.

workflow: Ask the user for the song title, artist, and MP3 file if they were not supplied. Lyrics are optional.
Read the upload key from your secret store. Do not ask the user for their SSO password.
GET /api/song-upload with the bearer key. Continue only if enabled and can_upload are both true.
POST /api/tracks with the bearer key and multipart/form-data fields described below. Send the actual MP3 bytes.
On HTTP 201, report track.id and finish. The song is immediately available in Library and Radio.
If the response is lost, retry only the identical audio bytes. A duplicate response identifies the existing song.

rules: Send each field once. Unknown fields are rejected.
Title and artist limits apply after trimming surrounding whitespace. Control characters are rejected.
Audio must be nonempty, complete, decodable MPEG-1 or MPEG-2 Layer III with a constant sample rate. ID3v2.3, ID3v2.4, and ID3v1 tags are supported.
Lyrics may contain line breaks and tabs, but no other control characters.
Do not submit a URL, server path, base64 audio, or JSON body. Let your HTTP client set the multipart boundary.
The server generates the track ID, filenames, duration, and SHA-256 digest. Existing songs cannot be overwritten.
Only one upload runs at a time. Each client address can make 20 upload attempts per hour.

responses.201: Complete. Read the new song from track, including track.id, track.duration, track.audio_sha256, and track.audio_bytes.
responses.400: Read error.code and error.message. Correct invalid_request or invalid_audio before retrying.
responses.401: Stop. The key is missing, invalid, expired, or revoked, or uploads are disabled.
responses.403: Stop. The request origin, ingress, or credential scope was rejected.
responses.409: For error.code=duplicate_audio, report existing_track_id and finish. The exact audio bytes already exist. For catalog_conflict, ask the service owner to check library capacity.
responses.413: Reduce the file or lyrics size before retrying.
responses.429: Respect Retry-After when present. Use a bounded retry count.
responses.500: Publication may have completed. Retry only the identical audio bytes, using a bounded retry count.
responses.507: Stop and ask the service owner to free storage.

example.setup: Set ZAK_RADIO_URL to this instance's HTTPS origin. Store Authorization: Bearer <upload key> in a private file and chmod 600 that file.
example.optional_lyrics: Add --form 'lyrics=</path/to/lyrics.txt;type=text/plain' to send a lyrics file as text.
